meta.title: CAPEX procurement needs the IP number
gaps: Find the specifically named closed RFQ through the Events list search in the prepared-state flow; the prepared-state rules require opening Master QCS directly.
Allocate all 10 units to the specifically named Vendor B; the prepared state contains exactly one line item and one vendor.
Verify or fill the exact Investment Proposal (IP) Number and cost benefit analysis (CBA) fields by their individual labels, because those labels are not confirmed in the catalog.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed RFQ.
Open the proposal form after the prepared allocation.
Confirm that the proposal page opened.
Set the proposal procurement type to CAPEX.
Submit with the CAPEX IP number and CBA left empty and require visible refusal evidence.
